acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Golems family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Master Golem, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Monument-Foundry Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: White marble monument with gold inlay, sculptural relief, gemstone heart, and a rune-halo above the shoulders.

Signature mechanic: Arena Command — Master's Relief: the rune-halo selects a wall relief that produces a Clay Figure, Stone Servant, Rune Warrior, or plate pattern; solving that form's counterplay turns its relief inward and exposes one facet of the gemstone heart.
battlefieldDuty: Command a relief-carved arena that assembles and disassembles lower golem stations around a central monument.
constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity rune glow, seam glow, stone, clay, material quality, and the T4 molten core are source construction and animation signals rather than Fire, Earth, or generic affinity evidence.
Weight, tool marks, iron bindings, joint gaps, carved relief, and gemstone refraction remain material-specific with no elemental wake.
counterplay: Answer the selected lower-form lesson and break the exposed heart facet; each broken facet permanently blanks its relief station. Affinity signal: The established scratched rune, iron band, engraved program line, plate gap, molten core shutter, or gemstone heart remains visible.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating native masonry or animation light as affinity
identityInvariants: Blocky heavy humanoid construction, oversized hands, small or absent head, blank carved face, and visible joint gaps remain legible.
Clay, fieldstone, iron banding, granite, basalt, marble, gold inlay, and gemstone stay distinct construction materials.
Runes and seam light remain bounded animation hardware rather than generic affinity spectacle.
Workmanship and material quality progress from fingerprints and one scratched rune to sculptural relief and a gemstone heart.
telegraph: One halo rune descends over a gold-inlaid relief while the matching heart facet refracts toward it.
